semiconductor_relevance: High — KE Materials produces ultra-high purity organometallic precursors critical for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: KE Materials, a subsidiary of the Vital Group, specializes in the production and marketing of ultra-high purity organometallic precursors such as Trimethylaluminum (TMA), Trimethylgallium (TMG), Triethylgallium (TEG), and Hafnium tetrachloride (HfCl4). These materials are essential for the fabrication of semiconductor and LED chips, as well as applications in photovoltaics and displays.

regional_presence.Korea: Established in Pyeongtaek, Korea, focusing on synthesizing and purifying key materials for the semiconductor industry.
